lead.zh-Hans: 我们都让路，反倒一起堵住了门。
lead.en: We both made room and blocked the way together.

text.zh-Hans: 走到阿克拉东莱贡的努布克艺术空间，一位背宽布包的旅人正迎面过来。我向左让，他也向同一边让，换到右边又碰上了。我们停下来笑，我把脚并拢，请他先过。布包终于从身旁走远，他回头说待会儿出来再见。我答应这次站好，手指悄悄捏住了自己的裤缝。
text.en: At Nubuke in East Legon, a visitor with a wide cloth bag came towards me. I stepped aside; they chose the same side. We tried the other way and met again. We stopped, laughed, and I planted both feet so they could pass. They suggested meeting again on the way out. I promised to stay put, quietly gripping the seam of my trousers.

text.zh-Hans: 碰面时先站稳让对方走
text.en: Stay still and let the other person pass

text.zh-Hans: 看看宽布包需要多少空间
text.en: Notice how much room the wide bag needs

lead.zh-Hans: 我捡起的书，比我想的重一点。
lead.en: The book was heavier than I expected.

text.zh-Hans: 巴尔梅图书馆外，一位学生抱着几本书腾手开包，最下面一本滑到了地上。我赶紧帮他捡起，站直时才发现自己把书抱得太高，只露出一双眼睛。他笑着接过去，把书分装进两个袋子。我替他撑开一个袋口，等厚厚的书放稳，里面恰好还留着给水瓶的空隙。
text.en: Outside Balme Library, a student reached for a bag and let the bottom book in their stack slip to the ground. I picked it up and rose with it held so high that only my eyes showed above the cover. They accepted it with a smile and divided the books between two bags. I held one bag open. Once the thick volume was settled, there was just room beside it for a water bottle.

text.zh-Hans: 问问哪只袋子需要我扶着
text.en: Ask which bag needs holding open

text.zh-Hans: 看看书有没有放到袋底
text.en: Check that the book reaches the bottom

lead.zh-Hans: 叉子举起来，另一块也跟着来了。
lead.en: My fork brought an extra piece along.

text.zh-Hans: 我在阿克拉吃香料炸大蕉块，叉起一块时，旁边那块也粘着跟上来。我把叉子停在碗上，等它自己松开，结果两块都待得很牢。卖小吃的人递来另一把干净叉子，我轻轻分开，才得到合适的一口。碗边的几颗花生滚到一起，像在给这场小小的拆分留位置。
text.en: Eating kelewele in Accra, I lifted one piece of fried plantain and found another attached beneath it. I held the fork over my bowl, waiting for the second piece to let go. Both stayed firmly together. The vendor offered a clean extra fork. With a gentle nudge I separated them into manageable bites, while a few peanuts rolled together at the edge of my bowl.

text.zh-Hans: 谢谢多递来的那把叉子
text.en: Thank the vendor for the extra fork

text.zh-Hans: 看看两块大蕉在哪里贴住
text.en: Find where the two pieces joined

lead.zh-Hans: 豆子没掉在地上，躲进了袖口。
lead.en: The bean missed the floor and found my cuff.

text.zh-Hans: 吃瓦切豆饭时，一粒豆子从勺边滚走，我低头找了半天，桌上地上都没有。抬手喝水，袖口忽然鼓起一个小点。我小心把手臂放平，豆子便滚回空碟，发出一声轻响。邻座忍着笑，把碟子往我这边推近。我把袖口卷高，剩下的豆饭终于都从勺子走进了嘴里。
text.en: A bean escaped from my spoonful of waakye, but I could find it neither on the table nor on the floor. When I lifted my water, a small bump appeared inside my cuff. I levelled my arm carefully, and the bean rolled into an empty dish. My neighbour pushed the dish closer with a suppressed smile. I rolled up the cuff before returning to the rice and beans.

text.zh-Hans: 告诉邻座豆子藏去了哪里
text.en: Tell my neighbour where the bean hid

text.zh-Hans: 检查卷好的袖口
text.en: Check my rolled-up cuff

lead.zh-Hans: 我问完了话，才记起还没吃。
lead.en: I finished my question and remembered my waiting lunch.

text.zh-Hans: 瓦切豆饭和炸大蕉块都摆好了，我却和邻座聊起自己的邮包。他问里面有没有午饭，我连忙摇头，想解释自己已经点了两样，手里的勺子便一直举着。对方轻轻指了指勺里，我才看见那一口饭还没入口。我请他等我咽下再说，放下的勺子在碗边碰出很轻的一声。
text.en: My waakye and kelewele were ready, but I was telling my neighbour about my mailbag. They asked whether it carried lunch. I shook my head and began explaining the two dishes I had ordered, keeping my spoon raised throughout. A small gesture towards it reminded me of the uneaten mouthful. I asked for a moment to swallow. The spoon made a quiet tap as I set it beside the bowl.

text.zh-Hans: 咽下这一口再继续聊
text.en: Finish the mouthful before continuing

text.zh-Hans: 看看一直举着的勺子
text.en: Notice the spoon I kept raised

lead.zh-Hans: 碗底翘着，原来底下藏了盖子。
lead.en: The bowl was tilted by its own lid.

text.zh-Hans: 我把外带的瓦切豆饭放上桌，又把炸大蕉块摆到旁边，发现饭碗总向自己歪。我用手扶住，换个方向还是歪，只好端起来看。原来刚才掀开的盖子压在碗底，翘出一个角。把盖子拿开以后，两碗终于站平。我把空盖扣在一旁，凹面里正好接住一颗滑落的花生。
text.en: I set down my takeaway waakye with kelewele beside it, but the rice bowl kept tilting towards me. Turning it did not help. When I finally lifted it, I found its removed lid caught underneath. With that out of the way, both bowls stood level. I placed the empty lid beside them. Its hollow caught a peanut that had slipped from the other bowl.

text.zh-Hans: 说说碗底藏着的小盖子
text.en: Tell how the lid hid under the bowl

text.zh-Hans: 看看两只碗是否放平
text.en: Check that both bowls sit level

lead.zh-Hans: 你说“{reply}”，我把双脚牢牢并好了。
lead.en: You wrote, “{reply}.” I kept my feet together.

text.zh-Hans: 从努布克艺术空间出来，那位背宽布包的旅人果然还在。我照约定站好，请他先走，这回两个人没有再一起左右挪动。可我为让路把邮包抱到肚子前，宽布包经过时，两个包的圆扣还是轻轻碰了一下。我们同时低头检查，布包没事，邮包上多挂了一根细细的蓝线。
text.en: Leaving Nubuke, I found the visitor with the wide bag waiting as arranged. I kept my feet together and let them pass, without our previous sideways dance. I had hugged my own bag against my middle, though, and the two round buckles touched. We both looked down to check. Their bag was fine; a fine blue thread had caught on mine.

text.zh-Hans: 说明这次只是包扣碰了面
text.en: Explain that only our buckles met this time

text.zh-Hans: 把包扣上的细线取下来
text.en: Remove the thread from my buckle

lead.zh-Hans: 伞收好了，我却还握着伞套。
lead.en: The umbrella was packed, but I still held its sleeve.

text.zh-Hans: 回阿克拉的路上，我又绕到巴尔梅图书馆外，想在这里歇歇脚。一位学生正把收好的伞塞进袋里，伞套却从手边滑落。我递过去时，他已经把拉链拉到底，只好再开一次。谁知我还牢牢捏着套子的另一端，袋子被扯出一条皱纹。我们一起松手，细长的伞套终于整个落进了袋子。
text.en: On returning to Accra, I stopped outside Balme Library for a rest. A student was packing a closed umbrella, but its sleeve slipped from their hand. I passed it over just after they zipped the bag shut, so they opened it again. I was still holding the far end when they tried to put it away, pulling a crease in the bag. We both relaxed our hands, and the long sleeve finally slid right inside.

text.zh-Hans: 说说我一直没松开的手
text.en: Explain that I forgot to let go

text.zh-Hans: 看看伞套是否完全收好
text.en: Check that the sleeve is fully packed
